parameters.name: FlvVideoSeekMode
parameters.description:
The FLV seek mode. Valid values:
- by_byte: seek by byte.
- by_time: seek by time.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two usage scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0.

parameters.name: VideoSeekEnable
parameters.description:
The video seek (drag-and-play) switch. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.
